name: bolt.new Open Graph social card by bolt.new
description: A 1200×630 dark social card split into a quiet left half and a product-teaser right half. The bolt.new wordmark sits large, bold and italicised on the left with a two-line gray tagline beneath, while the right half shows three stacked chat panels receding toward the top-right, cropped off the canvas edge to imply a bigger app. Depth is carried by a soft blue radial glow in the top-right corner and a sharp white light streak grazing the top edge of the rearmost panel; the frontmost panel reads as a prompt input with placeholder text and paperclip/sparkle icons. Type is a single sans family scaled in three steps — wordmark, tagline, UI text — with muted blue-gray on near-black doing all the contrast work.
